source_content_denominator: Every frozen annotation content unit, including visual-only wordmarks/footer and uncertainty. PA057 33; CS010 45. No unit removal or denominator changes.
page_text: Material blocks in returned order filtered to a source_refs page_index matching the original page. Text/heading/image use text; table uses rows in row-major order, cells joined by newline; blocks joined by newline. No sorting to repair product output.
strict_containment: Case-sensitive exact complete annotation text substring in raw same-page page_text. Annotation paragraph wrapped lines are joined by single spaces as frozen. No fuzzy edits, dehyphenation, punctuation replacement or reordered matching.
normalized_containment: Same as strict, after both sides use Python str.split() then a single-space join only. This is whitespace-normalized full containment, reported separately from strict and not substituted for a claim about exact structural fidelity.
fragment_diagnostic: For native-assisted units, each frozen original assistance line is normalized and checked independently on the same page. Full fragment coverage can reveal preserved but fragmented text; it is never complete-unit recall. Visual-only units use their whole source visual text as one fragment.
critical_spans: Every frozen critical substring must occur after whitespace-only normalization on the expected original page. Full phrase spans and contained numeric spans are both scored as frozen. Failure is flagged; present substrings do not prove their condition has been associated correctly. Provide source page and matching product block refs.
structure: Report each predeclared relation and type. under_heading/heading_parent require unique text-matched actual heading block and product parent_id. note attachment requires explicit parent/dependency. table_cell_position/column_header require expected same-page row/column values inside the same product table. list_member requires explicit parent/dependency. precedes requires normalized complete unit occurrence order on the same page; same-unit evidence or missing/ambiguous matches are unresolved, never inferred pass. Missing model representation counts FAIL for expected relationship; ambiguity is UNMEASURED. Text occurrence order is reported as order evidence only, not full hierarchy accuracy.
oracle_classifier: Run existing literal classifier only on frozen requirement_evaluation_units source text. Use source_heading for heading kind, otherwise source_text. Do not feed expected class or positive-specific kind. Context is negative for binary proposal diagnostics; undetermined reference remains a separate stratum with no relabeling. Report requirement/context/undetermined predictions, not end-to-end precision/recall. PA057 has zero positive references and recall undefined.
independence: Source annotations visually inspected and withheld from this round's predictions before freeze. Both documents historically exposed; CS010 text assistance shares PDFium engine. No all-history independent holdout claim.
post_measurement_boundary: No parser debugging or product edits from these results during this task. Reuse for development consumes this round's withheld status and requires recording exposure. Preserve all outputs and failures.
